authoritative_rule: Agents MUST refresh current main and repository evidence before selecting or claiming a slot. queue_anchor_main_sha is an audit anchor, not permission to work from a stale base. The current snapshot retains only actionable OPEN slots; completed/promoted slots remain auditable in Git history and must not be re-claimed or force-moved.

auto_assignment.selection_rule: Choose the highest-priority OPEN slot allowed for the agent role whose dependencies are satisfied and whose runtime/planning boundary remains valid on current main.
auto_assignment.claim_branch_rule: Use the exact claim_branch declared by the slot. Create that remote branch from the exact current main SHA without force. Successful remote ref creation claims the slot. If the branch already exists or ref creation is rejected, treat the slot as already claimed and immediately evaluate the next eligible slot.
auto_assignment.no_valid_slot_behavior: Make no repository changes and report NO_VALID_WORK_SLOT.
revalidation_before_work: Read AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CHECKPOINT.md and docs/ENGINEERING-EXECUTION-GOVERNANCE.md.
Read current main SHA and commits since the queue audit anchor.
Inspect relevant open and merged PRs/MRs and existing branches.
Verify the selected slot is not already complete, superseded, blocked or claimed.
Verify canonical ownership, dependency order and allowed write scope.
Only then create the deterministic claim branch.
revalidation_before_merge: Absorb latest main using the repository-approved non-destructive strategy.
Review the intended diff and Integration Requirements.
Require applicable exact-head CI on the final candidate head.
Never use stale CI or force overwrite as merge evidence.

SUPERVISOR.description: Exactly one user-designated Supervisor/Integrator coordinates shared writes, merge review, queue reconciliation and supervisor-only slots. This role is explicit because independent AI sessions do not have a reliable cross-session lease/heartbeat mechanism.
must_not: Merge a branch only because an agent says it is done.
Treat arrival order as merge order.
Allow dependency-blocked runtime work to start.

WORKER.description: Workers autonomously inspect current repository truth and claim the next eligible non-overlapping work slot using deterministic remote branch creation.
must_not: Modify shared/global truth unless the slot explicitly grants that write scope.
Create a different branch name when the deterministic claim branch is already occupied.
Start runtime work that the slot marks planning_only or dependency_blocked.
